description: Use typed objects (dataclasses, classes) instead of dictionaries for structured data. Dict[str, Any] and untyped lists hide the structure of data, prevent IDE autocomplete, and allow runtime errors that could be caught at compile time. Define explicit types for action contexts, configuration, and any structured data passed between components.

content: Define explicit types for action parameters:

examples.description: Don't use Dict[str, Any] for structured data
content: Avoid generic dictionaries when structure is known:
# WRONG - hides structure, no type safety
def do_execute(self, parameters: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
scope = parameters.get('scope')  # What keys does scope have?
background = parameters.get('background', False)  # Easy to typo
# WRONG - spreads kwargs obscures what's accepted
- parameters: Dict[str, Any] for action methods
- Return type Dict[str, Any] when structure is known
- Passing dicts between components when structure is fixed
